title: Import PostgreSQL Schema
description: As a database designer, I want to import an existing PostgreSQL schema as a diagram so that I can visualize and work with an existing database.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a connection to PostgreSQL is established, when the user requests to import a schema, then the application retrieves tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes
And the schema is rendered as an editable diagram on the canvas

evidence: Implementation present on branch ticket/STORY-013 (committed via main): src/App.tsx (handleImportSchema, Import Schema button rendered when connected, setDiagram(schemaToDiagram(result)) renders on canvas), src/connection/readSchemaApi.ts (POST /api/read-schema retrieves tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, indexes), src/connection/schemaToDiagram.ts (converts read-schema response into editable Diagram model with tables/columns/PK/relationships/unique constraints/indexes, auto-arranged in grid), src/components/App.schema-import.test.tsx (integration test: calls read-schema endpoint and renders imported tables on canvas).
STORY-013 unit tests all pass: src/__tests__/readSchemaApi.test.ts (9 tests), src/__tests__/schemaToDiagram.test.ts (8 tests), src/components/App.schema-import.test.tsx (1 test).
Full suite: 395 tests passed across 31 test files (vitest run, jsdom).
Type check: no TS errors in STORY-013 files (App.tsx, readSchemaApi.ts, schemaToDiagram.ts, App.schema-import.test.tsx). Pre-existing errors only in unrelated test files.
Lint: no ESLint errors in STORY-013 files. Pre-existing errors only in unrelated test files.
Build: npm run build (tsc && vite build) completes successfully.
